text:
maria: Quick thought — we should add an SDK + header knob for region preference + customer-tier override so client teams can bias routing without changing account config. e.g. header `X-RW-Region: eu-west-1` and `X-RW-Tier: gold` to prefer dedicated pools. Thoughts?
kevin: +1 for a header, but need clear precedence rules. If region is overloaded, should tier override force cross-region? :thinking_face:
sudha: I'd prefer policy: region hint = soft preference, tier override = hard preference (if capacity and quota allow). Model-variant fallback needs to respect safety: never fallback to unverified low-quant model for enterprise tier unless explicitly allowed.
alyssa: Telemetry / billing implication — we need to emit `route.choice` and `route.resolve_reason` so Console can show why a request was routed. Something like `route.choice: dedicated|hosted|fallback-quantized` and `route.resolve_reason: capacity|quota|latency` so cost dashboards match what actually happened.
tom: For SDK ergonomics: add `clientOptions.regionHint` and `clientOptions.tierOverride`. Keep headers optional so existing customers unaffected. Also add `debugRoute=true` flag but gate it behind `DEBUG_ROUTES` feature flag for internal use.
maria: Agree on telemetry props. Can we standardize a short set: `rw.route.selected`, `rw.route.reason`, `rw.model.variant`? Console can map those to lanes.
kevin: Edge-case: what if header requests cross-region but KMS/Privacy rules block it? We must validate policy server-side and return 403 if forbidden. Also ensure we don't silently route to cross-region.
sudha: For fallback ordering proposal: 1) exact model & region, 2) model variant same region (quantized / lower-memory), 3) same model different region (if tier allows), 4) alternate model family (with quality label) — each step must add a `rw.route.reason`.
alyssa: UX/rollouts: in Console rollout page show a histogram: "route resolution breakdown" for the canary vs baseline. That requires us to tag eval traces with `route.resolution_bucket`. Small change but huge value for PMs.
tom: Compatibility: ensure server returns `x-rw-applied-routing: region=eu-west-1;tier=gold;model=redwood-3q` header in response for easy local debugging. Also include a compact `x-rw-trace` id for correlation.
maria: Regex for headers: allow both `X-RW-Tier` and `x-rw-tier` — normalize. SDK should translate `clientOptions.tierOverride` to header.
kevin: Quotas: If a gold-tier header is used by a non-gold account, server should ignore and emit `rw.route.reason=invalid_tier_override` telemetry and increment a metric. Do not shadow quota checks.
sudha: Model-variant fallback must log prompt-preserving reasons for quality monitoring. If we fall back to a quantized model for cost, tag `rw.model.fallback_type=quantized` so Optimize can surface regressions.
alyssa: Also add sampling for full prompt + final model output for early detection. Keep it opt-out for enterprise customers who restrict PII.
maría (typo fix): small note — our i18n clients sometimes send `Region` header capitalized; normalization handles it, but add tests.
tom: Test plan: unit tests for header precedence, e2e simulation that toggles `DEBUG_ROUTES` flag and asserts header in response, and telemetry end-to-end test verifying `rw.route.selected` flow.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: route-header-feature branch -> staging at 1912345685 :rocket:
kevin: After deploy, can we do a quick smoke to ensure no unintended cross-region routing? I'll run a load test with `regionHint: ap-southeast-1` and see behavior.
sudha: One more: for private deployments, header should be honored only if admin enables `allow_client_routing_overrides` in private config. Add config flag docs.
alyssa: I'll stub Console UX where rollout page can toggle "show client hints" and surface `regionHint`/`tierOverride` in request table.
maria: Thanks all — I'll draft the RFC with the fallback matrix, telemetry keys, SDK mapping, and sample headers. Ping me in this thread with comments. :thumbsup:
